datasheet_identity.title: BZT52B2V4 THRU BZT52B51 SURFACE MOUNT ZENER DIODES

extraction_notes: BZT52B15 table values at TA = 25 °C: VZ is 14.70 V minimum, 15.00 V nominal, and 15.30 V maximum at IZT = 5 mA. The nominal value is represented as typical and the min/max bounds are retained here as notes.

The Fig. 1 target trace was digitized from the plotted vector curve. Its x-axis is reverse-zener-voltage magnitude and its y-axis is reverse-zener-current magnitude on a logarithmic scale; points are not forward-bias points.

The datasheet gives maximum zener impedances of 30 ohm at IZT = 5 mA and 200 ohm at IZK = 1 mA for BZT52B15, plus admissible zener current IZM = 5 mA. These are not scalar fields in this schema and are not used as fitted curve points.

Capacitance and dynamic impedance appear only as multi-device characteristic plots on page 3 without an unambiguous target-specific scalar reading, so capacitance is omitted rather than invented. Reverse-recovery time is not specified.
omission_reason: No numeric zero-bias capacitance or reverse-recovery time is specified for BZT52B15; the page-3 capacitance plot is multi-device and not unambiguous enough for a target scalar.
